description: [Requires sign-in] Concrete next steps to get recommended by personal agents and to become reachable, understandable, and buyable. Pass a readiness check id and/or the brand, category, store URL, and competitors that were recommended instead. Uses the check's evidence when an id is given. Does not start a new check.

brand.description: Brand name, if you want recommendation steps.

mentioned.description: Whether any benchmark persona mentioned the brand.

recommended.description: Whether any benchmark persona recommended the brand for the category.

scan_id.description: Optional readiness check id from check_agent_readiness.
